title: Having so much fun in my sandbox dungeon crawler
author: thetinytrex
selftext:
Inspired by Skyrim shenanigans and Divinity Original Sin 2, I'm working on a dungeon exploring game where you keep getting more and more build changing skills with each boss defeated. I have the most fun in games playing weird builds and doing things that feel broken by messing with game systems. The concept is just pairing a "Source" and a "Form". So "Fire" + "Bolt" for fire bolt, or "Force" + "Bolt" = knockback. But this keeps growing as you gain new Sources and Forms. You start out with "Force" + "Grasp" = Telekinesis which is probably overpowered but stupid fun. You can grab enemies, grab their weapons and throw it so they chase after it, drop enemies into pits, etc. I'm still in the first week but already having a ton of fun playing it and wanted to share and get ideas. I'm working on "Self" as a form next, then adding Ice, Teleport, Link, Charm, and many others. The goal is to have many ways to play and have many options to get through a puzzle or encounter. Boss fights have a "pacifist" option to beating it. So far I'm 2 levels in and have many more planned.   
I built this game for myself. I'm not trying to make a quick buck and just enjoy the game dev process. Built with Opus 5.5 using about a 80% of the $20 pro plan.
